title: Petition of EUA Power Corporation, as a debtor-in-possession, and the Official Bondholders Committee of EUA Power Corporation to the Department of Public Utilities pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.07(2), for an investigation of the actions of Boston Edison Company and for a determination of eligibility in Boston Edison Company's RFP 3 soliciting the supply of power from qualifying facilities and independent power producers.
